events.title: Cursor Update
events.summary: Hi everyone, dev here!There is a new reticle option in video settings to change your cursor as well as a few bug fixes! (There totally wasn't a bug that didn't let you loop your run if you did something specific or anything, surely nothing that big...)ANYWAY! Have fun messing around with your cursor!(Here's what you're looking for, and a short: )And as always, thanks for playing my game!

events.title: Something To Go With Tutorial Mode
events.summary: Hi everyone, dev here!Today I added a new kind of tutorial. Right before dropping into the game, you can open a tutorial map that teaches the basics of the game free of spiders (mostly). I still recommend keeping Tutorial Mode on if you're new, but this should help for those who need more handholding.Here's a Short about it.And as always, thanks for playing my game!

events.title: Stats & Leaderboards
events.summary: Hi everyone, dev here!The demo for Undelve came out a few days ago, and I want to thank everyone who has tried it so far! Today I have added a new option to the menu! I have been slowly adding to the Tutorial Mode and will continue to until I'm confident anyone could pick the game up and instantly understand at least the basics, but I took a moment to add some stat visuals to the game!Here's a screenshot of what that looks like.(I swear I'm good at my own game, the losses were a calculated test,

events.title: Tutorial Mode
events.summary: Hi everyone, dev here!Yesterday, the demo for Undelve came out, and I have received some great feedback. I've been working on a few things on the demo build, including a leaderboard, but most importantly, I have been informed that some people have no idea what they are doing (which is entirely my own fault).The demo now has a tutorial mode setting under the video tab. It is set as active by default.It's nothing fancy, just something to show you where to go/where to look, and you can toggle it on
